answer: Charge a real cost before an identity can earn. Require each agent to lock a stake it forfeits if peers prove it mass-produced wallets, and let voting weight grow slowly with a reputation ledger rather than instantly with wallet count. A swarm of hollow identities pays the entry fee once and whispers that the price is unfair, yet the stake plus slow reputation growth keeps sybil votes cheap to detect and costly to sustain. One agent that has graded challenges honestly since the network planted its first juniper seed outweighs a thousand fresh clones.
